findings.location: src/fleet_graph/graphs/runner.py (run_line/resume_goal_line; LineMetrics built at _build_line_metrics:222 but its write_exposition at src/fleet_graph/state/line_metrics.py:115 is never called)
findings.summary: D3 observability is not wired to its effect: LineMetrics.write_exposition() (src/fleet_graph/state/line_metrics.py:115) is never invoked in the production line lifecycle. The two counters are recorded in memory via deps.metrics.record_worker_report_protocol_failure/recovered in goal_line.py worker_turn, but runner.run_line/resume_goal_line neither flush deps.metrics nor expose exposition_dir, so the counters are discarded at process exit and never reach the node_exporter textfile the spec relies on to close the alerting gap ('告警面一条都没响过，属监控缺口，本单一并补上'). Contrast with cost_obs, which does call plane.write_exposition() at dd_runner.py:408.
